_source: Internal Onboarding SOP - Update Date 07/31/2026 (Lark doc, RACI tables per flow; captured 2026-09-10)
_durations: days = upper bound of the SOP estimate; all steps in a stage share the stage window; stages run sequentially

OPM assigned once docs are received, to initiate onboarding
Set up an internal Lark group to streamline communication (auto)

stages.name: Routing & AM assignment
steps: Confirm brand routing & AM (skip if AM already set)

stages.name: Shop build
steps: Create & set up shop (warehouse, tax, finance)
Update Marketplace Seller in Shelf + Connect
Once built, use shop code to get SKM verification (Catherine)

stages.name: CQ & brand authorization
steps: Escalate to TikTok Support if still blocked
Provide corrected documents if CQ/BA is rejected
AM helps resolve rejected CQ/BA docs with brand

stages.name: Product listing
steps: Sync Shelf once Marketplace listing exists

stages.name: Waiting for inventory
steps: Resolve sync issues with Fulfillment team

stages.name: Final check / live
steps: Request audit from Ops Team Lead

stages.name: Binding
steps: Add CS & account-health email, notify teams
File Ops task to create Euka / IPPC accounts
